Short answer

To install mise on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add mise-bin. It is a 49.9 MB download (144.2 MB installed), version 2026.10.15-1, licensed MIT. dev tools, env vars, task runner. Free and open source.

Install mise on Omarchy

mise is a command-line tool that replaces a pile of separate version managers (like nvm, pyenv, rbenv) with one binary. It installs and switches between versions of programming languages and dev tools per project, loads project-specific environment variables automatically when you cd into a directory, and can define and run project tasks, all driven by a single mise.toml config file.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add mise-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 2026.10.15-1:
    pacman -Qi mise-bin

Open and use mise

mise has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql mise-bin | grep /usr/bin/

mise requirements and compatibility

No special requirements are documented for mise.

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: MIT.

omarchy pkg drop mise-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install mise on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add mise-bin. The download is 49.9 MB and it takes 144.2 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is mise free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall mise?

Run omarchy pkg drop mise-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does mise depend on?

mise declares no dependencies in the Omarchy package database.

Is mise a desktop app?

No. mise has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is mise in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as mise-bin (version 2026.10.15-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. jdx makes it. Project site: https://github.com/jdx/mise.
